name: Ancient Egyptian (Advanced Language Study)
description: Certificate of Advanced Language Study in Ancient Egyptian offered by the Department of Near Eastern Languages and Civilizations. A certificate adviser advises students on the certification process. The certificate is listed on the student's transcript once completed.
notes: Letter grade B or above required in all courses
Declare candidacy on Yale Hub as early as possible, no later than January 15 or September 15 of final semester
With adviser approval, an advanced texts seminar and/or graduate seminar may count toward requirements
Up to two courses of credit-bearing academic study abroad may be substituted with prior permission

policy.sourceNote: All courses must be taken for a letter grade, and students must achieve a grade of B or above.

requirements.name: Courses beyond L3
requirements.description: Four courses beyond the L3 level in Ancient Egyptian. At least two must be Yale courses designated L5.
